The role requires clear, structured communication of findings to non-technical stakeholders.

requirements.text: Defines and maintains the platform's usage and reliability metrics in the analytics warehouse.
Investigates metric anomalies with the platform team and documents causes and fixes.
Presents findings to product management and customer-facing teams in a structured way.
Coordinates metric changes with the platform and data engineering teams and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents metric definitions, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each change.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Data Product Analyst, Low-Code Application Platform

## Experience

- Defined the platform's weekly active builders, app publish rate and app error-rate metrics in the analytics warehouse (dbt models on BigQuery) and maintained the metric definitions page.
- Investigated the April drop in app publish rate with the platform team, traced it to a permission change in the publishing service and documented the cause and the fix in the analytics incident log.
- Presented monthly findings to product management and quarterly findings to the customer success team, using a standard deck with metric trend, cause and recommended follow-up for each anomaly.
- Coordinated metric definition changes with the platform and data engineering teams through the data change process, recording my ownership of the definitions and data engineering's ownership of the pipelines.
- Responsibilities included metric definition, anomaly investigation, stakeholder presentations and change coordination for the low-code platform over about two years.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the metric definitions page export and the April anomaly investigation write-up (timeline, cause, fix, verification query), with the warehouse query history as a verification trail.
